notes.title: V0.9.97 Update - 2 New Bosses!
notes.content:
With this update Zone of Lacryma will be even more challenging! Both bosses bring unique mechanics that will definitely test your skills.

[h1]New features & Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Mission 9's Boss
[*]Mission 10's Boss
[/list]


[h1]Improvements & Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*]C-Triangles now give 10 charge (down from 20)
[*]After using a charge bomb or energy shield, charge will be set to 5
[*]Higher weapon levels will slightly reduce the ship's speed with each shot
[/list]


[h1]Fixed Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*]Save game bug
[*]Enemies are activated a few pixels before entering the screen to avoid any visual issues
[/list]

notes.title: V0.9.9 Update
notes.content:
With this update Zone of Lacryma leaves Early Access! I managed to do most of the things I wanted, and feel that it is already worthy of a full release. The next couple of weeks will probably be all about fixing bugs and adjusting and balancing the game even further, so that I can eventually release V1.0.

Thanks for everyone that was part of the Early Access, and specially the ones that somehow helped make Zone of Lacryma a better game!


[h1]New features & Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Mission 11
[*]Ending sequence
[*]Options menu (windowed mode, resolution, music/audio volume)
[*]Total story time leader board (speedrun)
[*]New achievements
[*]Trading cards
[/list]


[h1]Improvements & Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased default ship speed by 10%
[*]Dialogue portrait updates
[*]Mission 6's cargo ship is now 20% faster than the prototype (instead of 10% slower)
[*]Combos give less charge (avoid infinite spamming)
[*]Larger font to increase readability
[/list]


[h1]Fixed Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*]Proper text wrapping in some of the time displays
[/list]

notes.title: V0.9.0 Update (early access)
notes.content:
With this update I'm trying to balance the game, making chasing highscores or speed runs as interesting as possible. It will also be the last update before the final release.


[h1]New features & Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]New destructible structures on every mission (speed run routes)
[*]Shooting now has a small recoil (slows ship down) that increases with weapon level
[/list]


[h1]Improvements & Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*]Story update
[*]Mission layout tweaks to accommodate the new destructible tiles
[*]Dialogue box size during gameplay adjusted to better fit text
[*]Removed difficulty selection (better balance the game + difficulty is based on player's play style)
[*]User interface updates automatically when changing input method (game pad or keyboard)
[*]Removed Walda's jump to simplify movement inside the ship
[*]Slow zones always trigger brake movement (even when using turbo)
[*]Charge bombs end turbo movement (avoid cheesing combos)
[*]Weapon level 3 and 4 charge cost decreased by 1
[*]Asteroid tile maps collision tweaks
[*]Adjusted bullet volume
[/list]


[h1]Fixed Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*]Creating a game in an empty slot would set weapon level to zero
[/list]


Sorry for the long wait, but life got in the way of the development! 
Anyway, enjoy!

notes.title: V0.8.0 Important Update (early access)
notes.content:
Big changes in the core mechanics of Zone of Lacryma!
This update will probably break your saved game!

[h1]New features & Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Energy meter removed. Shooting uses charge meter now.
[*]Turbo no longer requires energy (turbo can be turned on for the whole mission, if you can manage it).
[*]Combo increases weapon damage.
[*]When combo ends charge is recovered based on combo X.
[*]C-Triangles are only dropped by tougher enemies now. C-Triangles recover charge and reset combo meter to max.
[*]Charge Threshold allows energy shield and charge bomb to be used when charge amount is above the threshold (not max charge anymore).
[*]3 difficulty options.
[*]Bullet animation
[*]Turbo animation
[/list]


[h1]Improvements & Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*]Initial controls are clearer now when running the game for the first time.
[*]New heaven tilemap update
[*]Score is much higher now to avoid confusion with charge meter value.
[*]Available upgrades changed because of new mechanics.
[*]Tutorial updated for new mechanics.
[*]Combo text flashes every time combo increasing.
[*]Mission tweaks (enemies positions and quantity) because of new mechanics.
[/list]


[h1]Fixed Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[/list]


[h1]Known Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*]Mission 10 story still work in progress
[*]Game (rarely) gets stuck on loading screen (restart fixes this)
[/list]
